card.name: Error messages and file-system errors
card.fires_on: The first word or punctuation of a system error message, such as the colon before 'No such file or directory' or 'Read' in 'Read-only file system', mostly in Unix manuals and logs.

modes.label: Error text start
modes.description: Start of an operating-system error message in a command line or manual page.
modes.example: ls -l /dev/cd1bls: /dev/cd1b<<:>> No such file or directory ls -

modes.label: Error code lists
modes.description: First word of an error description after an error code in a man page.
modes.example: ENOSPC There was no room in the directory to add the new filename. EROFS<< Read>>-only file system.

modes.label: Warning or instruction openers
modes.description: Opening words of a warning or instruction like 'Never' or 'not'.
